These pages collect public evidence about people who appear in the CSIL history. They are **role records, not biographies**.

Each page separates:

1. documented roles supported by cited sources
2. later accounts and retrospective descriptions
3. unresolved claims or gaps
4. sources that mention the person

The archive does not infer design-group membership, formal authority, or a founder role simply because someone appears in Creekview or is described that way in a later source.

Please do not contact people named here, or their families or colleagues, without a separately agreed research protocol. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jordanforge-ca/csil-history/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
